vocabulary.note_ar: disagree with someone / about something. الاسم: disagreement
vocabulary.note_en: disagree with someone / about something. Noun: disagreement.
vocabulary.example: I disagree with you about the plan.
She disagreed politely with her manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how your voice goes up and down
(informal) certain to be won or achieved
vocabulary.example: Don't worry, the contract is in the bag.
I'd say the opposite is true.
Many customers are disgruntled about the prices.
Expensive things are not necessarily better.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a topic that people argue about strongly
vocabulary.example: Prices are a hot potato in the news.
The numbers just don't stack up.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very annoyed because something keeps happening
said to make people angry or start an argument
vocabulary.example: He said it just to be provocative.

vocabulary.note_ar: انتبه للنبرة: الضغط الزائد قد يجعلها وقحة
vocabulary.note_en: Careful: too much stress can sound rude.

fine_lines.title: Soft vs strong disagreement
fine_lines.explanation_ar: عبارات لطيفة: Not necessarily / I don't think so / I'd say the opposite. عبارات أقوى: How can you say that? / You can't honestly believe that / That's ridiculous. كلما قوي الضغط في الصوت بدت أقل تهذيبًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Soft: Not necessarily / I don't think so / I'd say the opposite. Stronger: How can you say that? / You can't honestly believe that / That's ridiculous. The more stress you add, the less polite it sounds.

examples.sentence: Will prices keep rising? Not necessarily.

fine_lines.title: agree with vs agree to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: agree with + شخص أو رأي. agree to + طلب أو خطة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Agree with" a person or opinion; "agree to" a request or plan.

examples.sentence: The boss won't agree to your plan.

expressions.meaning_en: Direct disagreement; can sound a bit rude.
expressions.example: Sorry, but I don't agree with you.

expressions.meaning_en: With a questioning tone, shows you doubt or disagree.
expressions.example: The order is in the bag. — Really? We still need confirmation.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to say you disagree.
expressions.example: We'll finish tomorrow. — I don't think so. There's a lot more to do.
A party on a school night? No way!

expressions.meaning_en: Says you think the opposite will happen.
expressions.example: You think they'll win? I'd say the opposite.

expressions.meaning_en: A soft, gentle way to disagree.
expressions.example: This company is going downhill. — Not necessarily.
How can you say that? They have lost everything.

expressions.meaning_en: Says an idea doesn't make sense, often about facts or numbers.
expressions.example: Make more products we can't sell? Where's the logic in that?

expressions.phrase: You can't honestly believe / think that.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا يمكن أن تصدّق / تظن ذلك بصدق.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you are surprised anyone could believe it.
expressions.example: You can't honestly think that's a good idea.

expressions.meaning_en: Checks if someone really means it.
expressions.example: Do you honestly think that we'll win easily?

expressions.phrase: It just doesn't make sense to me.
expressions.meaning_en: Disagrees and usually gives a reason.
expressions.example: Three journeys in one afternoon? It just doesn't make sense to me.

expressions.phrase: I hear what you're saying, but ...
expressions.example: I hear what you're saying, but I think there's a better way.

expressions.meaning_en: Strong disagreement; say it lightly or it may sound rude.
expressions.example: That's ridiculous! Nobody does that these days.

grammar.title: Intonation changes the meaning
grammar.explanation_ar: في عبارات مثل Really? وI don't think so وNo way يعتمد المعنى على النبرة. النبرة الصاعدة الهادئة تُظهر الشك بلطف، والضغط القوي يُظهر رفضًا قويًا وقد يبدو وقحًا.
grammar.explanation_en: With "Really?", "I don't think so" and "No way", meaning depends on intonation. A calm rising tone shows polite doubt; heavy stress shows strong disagreement and can sound rude.

grammar.title: Softening words: not necessarily, honestly, just
grammar.explanation_ar: كلمات مثل not necessarily وjust تجعل الاعتراض ألطف: It doesn't make sense ← It just doesn't make sense to me.
grammar.explanation_en: Words like "not necessarily" and "just ... to me" make disagreement softer: It doesn't make sense → It just doesn't make sense to me.
examples: It just doesn't make sense to me.
I don't think that's quite right.

questions.question: Which is the SOFTEST way to disagree?
questions.explanation_ar: Not necessarily طريقة لطيفة جدًا للاعتراض.
questions.explanation_en: "Not necessarily" is a very soft way to disagree.

questions.question: "Where's the logic in that?" means:
questions.explanation_en: It means the idea doesn't make sense.

questions.question: "The contract is in the bag" means:
choices: The contract is in my bag.
We are sure to get the contract.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول I don't agree with you. خطأ شائع: I'm not agree.
questions.explanation_en: Say "I don't agree with you". "I'm not agree" is a common mistake.

questions.question: Which phrase can sound RUDE if you stress it too much?
questions.explanation_ar: That's ridiculous قد تبدو وقحة مع الضغط القوي.
questions.explanation_en: "That's ridiculous" can sound rude with strong stress.

questions.question: "I'd say the opposite" means:
choices: I think the other way is true.
questions.explanation_en: It means you think the opposite.

questions.question: You ___ honestly believe that!
questions.explanation_ar: You can't honestly believe that = لا يمكن أن تصدّق ذلك.

questions.question: "It just doesn't make sense to me" is usually followed by:
questions.explanation_en: It is usually followed by a reason or alternative.

questions.question: A "hot potato" is:
questions.explanation_en: A hot potato is a controversial topic.

questions.question: "The numbers don't stack up" means:
choices: The numbers are in a pile.
questions.explanation_ar: stack up = يكون منطقيًا عند التحقق.
questions.explanation_en: It means the numbers don't make sense.
